assessment_basis: Independent review of coordinator-actuated current retest evidence; no direct T3 browser run.

items.task: Urgent help visibility at 844x320 with 200% app text and keyboard focus at end of menu
items.observation: Urgent help row fully visible; windowScrollY=0. Scoped to supplied state.

items.task: Sequential keyboard reach of all nine menu destinations at 320px/200% app text
items.observation: Nine link labels and focus bounds recorded; final About and privacy label fully visible. Inner scroll remains and earlier links scroll out of view as focus advances; no trap or clipped current label shown.
Long labels wrap; selected question and synthetic note appear in preview; keyboard Review focuses preview without save/export. Capture is a scrolled page portion, not proof all controls show at once.

items.task: Escape from card deletion confirmation and focus return
items.observation: Milestone confirmation dismisses on Escape; focus returns to Delete saved card and story remains. Practical-card evidence also reports named focus return.

items.observation: 200% refers to in-app text-size setting. No full WCAG or all-content geometric clipping claim.
